label: Initial complaint submission service
instruction: Generate the initial CMS submission service in modules/complaint_cms/services/complaints.py, maximum 75 lines. Define submit_complaint(actor, data) using existing models from modules.complaint_cms.models and domain helpers from modules.complaint_cms.domain.policy. Enforce complaint_cms.complaint.create permission via actor.has_permission (raising PermissionDeniedError from core.api.exceptions), validate required title and description (raising DomainValidationError), look up ComplaintCategory and optional RoutingRule, generate a unique tracking_code, compute sla_due_at using timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=...), and inside transaction.atomic() create the Complaint, initial ComplaintUpdate, initial ComplaintTask, and ComplaintNotification. Return the created Complaint instance. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
